text: At Christian Haute Couture, a Roman fashion house, the model Isabella is killed on the grounds at night by [a figure in a white featureless mask|images|dolls, masks and likenesses], black fedora and trenchcoat. She leaves behind [a diary of the staff's vices|trigger|a secret surfaces], and as it passes from hand to hand the killer stalks the models one by one with a spiked glove and a furnace. Inspector Silvestri rounds up the men of the salon, yet the deaths keep coming among [the models and staff|who_suffers|people at work].
